en: A monochrome postcard view of a countryside church landscape. On the right stands a simple white church building with a pitched roof, partially obscured by trees and bushes. On the left is a tall wooden free‑standing belfry made of several slanted supports holding a small roofed bell tower. The scene is set on a slightly rocky hill with a dirt path leading up toward a small entrance gate and the churchyard. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.
